events.title: Demo Updated For Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Deliver Pizza, Get Rewarded!Ahead of Peer-2-Pizza's participation in Steam Next Fest next week, a new update is now available for the game's demo!This update aims to improve the player level and challenge system in the demo through the new unlockable rewards system. events.title: Peer-2-Pizza Demo Available Now
events.summary: (first announcement, woo!)Start Delivering TodayAfter some time in the oven (maybe a little longer than I intended), a free demo for Peer-2-Pizza is available to play now! Peer-2-Pizza: First Slice features a selection of early levels from the full game which aims to give you a good taste of the game in its current state.
